test_decode_varint_bytes: test the _DecodeVarint function to decode variable-length integers from raw bytes at a given position
test_decode_varint_bytesio: test the _DecodeVarint function to decode variable-length integers from a BytesIO stream sequentially
test_decode_unknown_group_field: test the _DecodeUnknownField function to parse unknown group fields from protobuf wire format data
test_decode_unknown_group_field_nested: test the _DecodeUnknownField function to parse nested unknown group fields with multiple levels of nesting
test_is_default_scalar_value: test the IsDefaultScalarValue function to check if a scalar value equals its default type value
